# CustomWASM Language Reference

Generated from the EBNF grammar in `.cursor/memory/architecture.md`.

Whitespace and `//` line comments are skipped by the lexer. Identifiers may not be keywords.

Entry point: a `fn main() -> i32` is required; the playground calls its export.

## Program

### `program`

```ebnf
program = { functionDecl } ;
```

### `functionDecl`

```ebnf
functionDecl = "fn" IDENT "(" [ paramList ] ")" [ "->" type ] block ;
```

### `paramList`

```ebnf
paramList = param { "," param } ;
```

### `param`

```ebnf
param = IDENT ":" type ;
```

## Types

### `type`

```ebnf
type = "i32" | "f64" | "bool" | "string" | type "[" "]" ;
```

## Statements

### `block`

```ebnf
block = "{" { statement } "}" ;
```

### `statement`

```ebnf
statement = letStmt | assignStmt | ifStmt | whileStmt | returnStmt | exprStmt | block ;
```

### `letStmt`

```ebnf
letStmt = "let" IDENT [ ":" type ] "=" expression ";" ;
```

### `assignStmt`

```ebnf
assignStmt = lvalue "=" expression ";" ;
```

### `lvalue`

```ebnf
lvalue = IDENT | IDENT "[" expression "]" ;
```

### `ifStmt`

```ebnf
ifStmt = "if" "(" expression ")" block [ "else" ( ifStmt | block ) ] ;
```

### `whileStmt`

```ebnf
whileStmt = "while" "(" expression ")" block ;
```

### `returnStmt`

```ebnf
returnStmt = "return" [ expression ] ";" ;
```

### `exprStmt`

```ebnf
exprStmt = expression ";" ;
```

## Expressions

### `expression`

```ebnf
expression = logicalOr ;
```

### `logicalOr`

```ebnf
logicalOr = logicalAnd { "||" logicalAnd } ;
```

### `logicalAnd`

```ebnf
logicalAnd = equality { "&&" equality } ;
```

### `equality`

```ebnf
equality = comparison { ( "==" | "!=" ) comparison } ;
```

### `comparison`

```ebnf
comparison = additive { ( "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=" ) additive } ;
```

### `additive`

```ebnf
additive = multiplicative { ( "+" | "-" ) multiplicative } ;
```

### `multiplicative`

```ebnf
multiplicative = unary { ( "*" | "/" | "%" ) unary } ;
```

### `unary`

```ebnf
unary = ( "!" | "-" ) unary | postfix ;
```

### `postfix`

```ebnf
postfix = primary { call | index } ;
```

### `call`

```ebnf
call = "(" [ argList ] ")" ;
```

### `index`

```ebnf
index = "[" expression "]" ;
```

### `argList`

```ebnf
argList = expression { "," expression } ;
```

### `primary`

```ebnf
primary = INT | FLOAT | STRING | "true" | "false" | IDENT | "(" expression ")" | arrayLiteral ;
```

### `arrayLiteral`

```ebnf
arrayLiteral = "[" [ argList ] "]" ;
```
